# RequirementDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasRequirementDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasRequirementDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasRequirementDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasRequirementDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

SysML requirements with traceability and coverage

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasRequirementDiagramExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRequirementDiagramExamples.md)
- [UltraCanvasRequirementDiagramProposal](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasRequirementDiagramProposal.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasRequirementDiagram> CreateRequirementDiagram( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasRequirementDiagram(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `RequirementLayoutMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Manual` | positions set by the caller / by dragging |
| `ContainmentTree` | tidy tree over the containment relationships |
| `Layered` | Sugiyama-style layers for non-tree topologies |
| `ForceDirected` | spring model, for dense trace webs with no hierarchy |

### enum `RequirementOrientation`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TopDown` |  |
| `BottomUp` |  |
| `LeftRight` |  |
| `RightLeft` |  |

### enum `RequirementPaletteKind`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Classic` | white boxes, black lines - textbook SysML |
| `Pastel` | soft yellow/green fills |
| `Vibrant` | saturated per-kind colours |
| `Professional` | muted blue-grey |
| `Dark` |  |
| `Monochrome` | print / greyscale |
| `Custom` |  |

### enum `RequirementColorSource`

Where a node's fill colour comes from.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ByKind` | palette entry for the node kind |
| `ByCategory` | the category's colour |
| `ByRisk` | green / amber / red from the risk property |
| `ByStatus` | status string mapped through the status colour map |
| `Explicit` | RequirementNode::fillColor only |

### enum `RequirementPanelPosition`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TopLeft` |  |

| `BottomRight` |  |

### enum `RequirementLegendSource`

What the legend lists.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Categories` | one row per category actually used on the diagram |
| `NodeKinds` | one row per node kind actually used |
| `RelationKinds` | one row per relationship kind actually used |
| `Coverage` | satisfied / unsatisfied / unverified swatches |
| `Custom` | rows supplied via SetLegendEntries() |

### enum `RequirementEditMode`

Interaction mode.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Select` | select, drag, rubber-band |
| `CreateNode` | click empty canvas to create a node |
| `CreateRelation` | drag from one box to another to connect them |
| `Pan` | drag anywhere to pan |

What a double-click on a box does.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|

| `ToggleDetail` | Collapsed &lt;-&gt; Full (default) |
| `ToggleCollapse` | expand / collapse the sub-tree |
| `Rename` | start the inline name editor |
